verdict.rationale: Lemon Squeezy's own marketing says it accepts payments out of the box with zero setup as merchant of record, and offers shareable or embeddable checkout links and a store built in minutes. That supports quick payment acceptance. However, nothing in the pack documents the actual sign-up-to-first-payment timeline (account verification or store activation), and card payments are only implied by '21 payment methods'. Missing for 10: documented onboarding/activation timeline proving payments can go live within a day, explicit card-payment support, independent or hands-on corroboration of time-to-first-payment.

support.subject: As a founder, I can accept an online card payment within a day of signing up
